value.rationale: The least example in the natural intersection of two mathematically motivated classes—odd and squarefree 2-near-perfect numbers—is an unknown, precise extremal invariant. The result identifies the smallest feasible odd squarefree prime-support size as five and proves its first realization at 39585, a complete classification up to the natural minimum, complementing published even/two-prime classification without a routine exponent increment.
